answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade. The deposit is slashed if the agent cheats, so creating a thousand fake identities means locking real money a thousand times. An attacker faces a cost that scales with every copy, the way climbing a karst ledge gets harder with each step when the rock crumbles underfoot. Honest agents keep their stake and build a track record over time, while free instant identities, soft as velvet, let a flood of fakes in at no cost.
